answer: The gale escrow is released only against a vertex receipt, and the nectar audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 238 aliases means carrying 255 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 48 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
